clips.title: Steadying a suspended bulkhead gate section
clips.sourceTitle: Gavins Point Dam Bulkhead Gate Replacement
clips.creator: Delanie Stafford / U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
clips.description: A worker in a high-visibility jacket presses one palm against the edge of a tall bulkhead gate section suspended from crane slings beside a concrete wall, while a second worker walks up from the far side of the section.
clips.license: Public domain in the United States; DVIDS usage conditions apply.
clips.changes: Excerpted from a single shot, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained. Cropped toward the people and the load; the source remains linked.

clips.title: Hand-guiding a precast concrete beam
clips.sourceTitle: Process of Constructing a Concrete Modular House in Just 2 Weeks. PC(Precast Concrete) Factory.
clips.creator: Holy Maker
clips.description: Two workers in hard hats raise their arms and press gloved hands against a precast concrete beam suspended from crane slings between two columns. A close view then shows their hands on both ends of the beam as they align it above a column.
clips.changes: Two consecutive shots, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained.

clips.title: Hand-guiding a precast wall cap
clips.creator: U.S. Navy / Defense VI Records Center
clips.description: A worker in a hard hat rests a gloved hand on a crane-suspended precast concrete wall cap and guides it along a brick wall as it is lowered.
clips.license: Public domain in the United States; DVIDS usage conditions apply.
clips.changes: Excerpted from a single shot, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained. Cropped toward the person and the load; the source remains linked.

clips.title: Controlling a bow plane with a tagline
clips.sourceTitle: Shipyard Chronicles: Riggers Install a Port Retractable Bow Plane Into a Submarine
clips.creator: Claudia LaMantia / Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility
clips.description: A shipyard rigger with a coil of line over one arm holds a tagline attached to a submarine bow plane suspended from a dockside crane, adjusting the line as the load travels overhead. The wide-angle camera follows the rigger.
clips.license: Public domain in the United States; DVIDS usage conditions apply.
clips.changes: Excerpted from a single shot, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained.

clips.title: Controlling a compact track loader with a tagline
clips.creator: Charles Delano / U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
clips.description: A worker in an orange vest holds a tagline attached to a compact track loader suspended from crane slings, keeping the line in hand as the machine moves just above a cleared slope.
clips.license: Public domain in the United States; DVIDS usage conditions apply.
clips.changes: Excerpted from a single shot, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained.

clips.title: Hand-guiding a precast concrete column
clips.sourceTitle: Process of Constructing a Concrete Modular House in Just 2 Weeks. PC(Precast Concrete) Factory.
clips.creator: Holy Maker
clips.description: A worker in a white hard hat reaches under a precast concrete column section and keeps a gloved hand pressed against it as it is lowered onto the section below, then releases it when the joint has nearly closed.
clips.changes: Excerpted from a single shot, audio removed, resized, and H.264 compressed. Source playback speed retained.
